prs.title: fix(client): avoid redundant fallback on root-like discovery paths
prs.author: raashish1601
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both rewrite the exact same trailing-slash-stripping logic in buildWellKnownPath() (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts) so that pathnames like '/foo//' don't produce malformed '.well-known' discovery URLs. #2214 replaces the single-slash `.slice(0,-1)` check with a `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex inline in buildWellKnownPath (and again in buildDiscoveryUrls). #2215 makes the identical regex change but factors it into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, and additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback()` to check for `pathname === ''` instead of `pathname === '/'` — because once trailing slashes are stripped, a root path normalizes to `''`, not `'/'`, so the old check never matched and caused a redundant fallback discovery request for root-level authorization servers. (2 PRs)

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the exact same trailing-slash-stripping logic in buildWellKnownPath() (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts) so that pathnames like '/foo//' don't produce malformed '.well-known' discovery URLs. #2214 replaces the single-slash `.slice(0,-1)` check with a `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex inline in buildWellKnownPath (and again in buildDiscoveryUrls). #2215 makes the identical regex change but factors it into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, and additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback()` to check for `pathname === ''` instead of `pathname === '/'` — because once trailing slashes are stripped, a root path normalizes to `''`, not `'/'`, so the old check never matched and caused a redundant fallback discovery request for root-level authorization servers.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make close() settle pending JSON-response-mode POSTs instead of leaving them hanging, but #2600 has a larger fix surface: it also clears the previously-uncleared `_requestToStreamMapping` entries and re-checks the correlation in send() after the storeEvent() await, closing a leak/race that lets a response get recorded after close() with nowhere to deliver it. #2600 also states the same fix is applied to NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport, which wraps this transport. #2692's diff is scoped to resolving the pending response promise (grouped per stream, reusing an already-produced real response, and using a -32000 JSON-RPC error body) but does not touch the _requestToStreamMapping leak or the send()/storeEvent() race that #2600 addresses, so merging #2600 and closing #2692 keeps the broader fix; #2692's batching/response-reuse and JSON-RPC error-body handling should be diffed against #2600's implementation before close to confirm no regression on those specific cases.

members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the exact same trailing-slash-stripping logic in buildWellKnownPath() (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts) so that pathnames like '/foo//' don't produce malformed '.well-known' discovery URLs. #2214 replaces the single-slash `.slice(0,-1)` check with a `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex inline in buildWellKnownPath (and again in buildDiscoveryUrls). #2215 makes the identical regex change but factors it into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, and additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback()` to check for `pathname === ''` instead of `pathname === '/'` — because once trailing slashes are stripped, a root path normalizes to `''`, not `'/'`, so the old check never matched and caused a redundant fallback discovery request for root-level authorization servers.
